# chart_stat_sop {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
chart_stat_sop(p_vec, chart_choice)
```
Compute the chart statistic of a spatial ordinal pattern (SOP) distribution `p_vec` for the given chart choice.
 
  * `p_vec`: vector of (relative) SOP type frequencies.
  * `chart_choice`: one of [`TauHat`](@ref)`()`, [`KappaHat`](@ref)`()`, [`TauTilde`](@ref)`()`, [`KappaTilde`](@ref)`()`, `Shannon()`, `ShannonExtropy()`, `DistanceToWhiteNoise()`.
Returns the value of the chart statistic.
 


:::
